The '''Pervickian dung camels''' were a type of creature from the [[Pervick system/Legends|Pervick system]].<ref name="som">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' </ref>

To be called a Pervickian dung camel or compared to one was considered an insult.<ref name="som" />
